meta.description: Style-weighted randomised combo scoring library. Each combo defines a score_range and dynamic {score} dialogue template.

combos.name: The Default NPC
combos.roast: {score}/40—grey skin, completely barefoot, and zero goo? You walked onto the runway without clicking a single fun option.

combos.name: Suburban Lawn Dad
combos.roast: Only {score}/40 for clean white sneakers on porcelain skin. Not a single drop of chaos to be found anywhere.

combos.name: Midnight Kitchen Raid
combos.roast: {score}/40! Barefoot straight into a puddle of maple syrup—every step across the runway now makes a horrifying squelch.

combos.name: Monday Morning Commute
combos.roast: {score}/40. Black sneakers stepped straight into swamp mud—less avant-garde, more missing the bus in the rain.

combos.name: Food Court Tragedy
combos.roast: Scored {score}/40! Classic black combat boots ruined by chewed bubblegum under the sole—edgy above, comedy below.

combos.name: Double Bubble Overload
combos.roast: {score}/40 for hot pink sneakers covered in matching pink bubblegum! We can barely tell where the shoe ends and the gum begins.

combos.name: Pancake Rodeo
combos.roast: A rootin'-tootin' {score}/40! Tan cowboy boots drenched in warm maple syrup—dangerously sticky frontier fashion.

combos.name: Permanent Sidewalk Statue
combos.roast: {score}/40! Steel-toe boots encased in solidifying wet cement. Zero mobility, 100% commitment to the bit.

combos.name: Studio 54 S'more
combos.roast: Groovy {score}/40! Metallic silver go-go platforms dripping with melted marshmallow—pure disco-era campfire chaos.

combos.name: Radioactive Lumberjack
combos.roast: Massive {score}/40! Alien green skin, neon lime combat boots, and maple syrup—summoning raccoons and OSHA at the same time.

combos.name: Ecological Catastrophe
combos.roast: Legendary {score}/40! Amber tree sap matted into giant electric-blue Fuzzy Yeti boots—you are now legally part of the forest floor.

combos.name: Paranormal Runway Supreme
combos.roast: Unstoppable {score}/40! Hot pink go-go platforms slathered in glowing ectoplasm on alien skin—a masterpiece of bad decisions.
